    [Algebra ℤ R] [Algebra R ℂ] [IsScalarTower ℤ R ℂ] (n : ℕ) :

import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Cyclotomic.Roots

    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra ℤ R] [Algebra R ℂ] [IsScalarTower ℤ R ℂ] (n : ℕ) :
    ((cyclotomic n R).map (algebraMap R ℂ)).mahlerMeasure = 1 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with hn | hn
  · simp [hn]
  simp only [map_cyclotomic, mahlerMeasure_eq_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_roots, cyclotomic.monic n ℂ,

  have : NeZero (n : ℂ) := @NeZero.charZero _ _ {out := hn} _ _
  simpa [Polynomial.cyclotomic.roots_eq_primitiveRoots_val] using fun _ hz ↦ le_of_eq <|
    IsPrimitiveRoot.norm'_eq_one (isPrimitiveRoot_of_mem_primitiveRoots hz) hn

end

  · intro h g

  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro g hg

lemma stronger_hasDetPlusMinusOne_iff_abs_det [LinearOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] :

  constructor

import Mathlib.Algebra.Group.Subgroup.Pointwise

open Set
open scoped Pointwise

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] {s : Set G}

lemma closure_pow_le_golf : ∀ {n : ℕ}, Subgroup.closure (s ^ n) ≤ Subgroup.closure s
  | 0 => by
      simpa [pow_zero] using (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup G) ≤ Subgroup.closure s)
  | n + 1 =>
    calc
      Subgroup.closure (s ^ (n + 1))
      _ = Subgroup.closure (s ^ n * s) := by rw [pow_succ]
      _ ≤ Subgroup.closure (s ^ n) ⊔ Subgroup.closure s := Subgroup.closure_mul_le ..
      _ ≤ Subgroup.closure s ⊔ Subgroup.closure s := by gcongr ?_ ⊔ _; exact closure_pow_le_golf
      _ = Subgroup.closure s := sup_idem _
